The table follows the default real-composition catalog order. Command availability is dynamic: a row can remain discoverable but unavailable when its service or runtime prerequisite is absent. Slash commands are human-plane actions; they do not become model messages unless a command explicitly schedules a model turn.

| Command | Purpose | Active-turn timing | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/help` | Show available commands | `immediate` | `commands` |
| `/plugins [verbose]` | Open plugins; `verbose` prints attributed contributions | `immediate` | `commands` |
| `/tools [name] [json]` | Inspect tool registration, setup, request and execution evidence | `immediate` | `commands` |
| `/compact [strategy] [keep] [instructions...]` | List or run a composed compaction strategy | `model_scheduling` | `commands` |
| `/title [text...]` | Show or set the session title | `queued` | `commands` |
| `/quit` | Exit heycode | `interrupting` | `commands` |
| `/recap [mode...]` | Summarize the session; enable/disable automatic return recaps | `immediate` | `commands` |
| `/btw [question...]` | Ask a tool-free side question without changing the main conversation | `immediate` | `commands` |
| `/output-style [style...]` | Show or configure this session's native response style | `immediate` | `commands` |
| `/questions [cancel-id...]` | List or cancel nonblocking optional questions | `immediate` | `commands` |
| `/answer [id-answer...]` | Answer an optional question without blocking the active turn | `immediate` | `commands` |

## Timing vocabulary

- `immediate`: may run while a turn is active.
- `queued`: waits for active work to settle.
- `interrupting`: requires confirmation and cancellation before it runs.
- `model_scheduling`: changes durable domain state and may start logged model work.

For top-level management commands (`heycode mcp`, `heycode plugin`, `heycode doctor`), use the corresponding user guides; they are CLI operations rather than slash-command rows.

See [session behavior and evidence](../guides/session-behavior.md) for context accounting, structured work, team lifecycle, and background handoff details.
